name: xxtars-plugins
description: Personal Claude Code plugins for ML research workflow

plugins.name: research-workflow
plugins.description: Research workflow scaffolding: four-layer PLAN (Story / Design / Execution / Iteration), LOG + weekly + PITFALLS conventions, and an iterate skill that feeds results back into story and design.

plugins.name: csc.fi-workflow
plugins.description: CSC (Finland) SLURM cluster workflow: sync code, check jobs, submit jobs, record results. Writes into files defined by research-workflow.

plugins.name: overleaf-workflow
plugins.description: Overleaf paper writing workflow: sync via git, academic writing conventions, reference management.

plugins.name: memory-workflow
plugins.description: Session wrap-up: categorize decisions, dead ends, assumption corrections, and open items; write user-approved entries to project files.

plugins.name: web-paper-to-pdf
plugins.description: Convert Distill-style web papers (transformer-circuits.pub, distill.pub, alignment.anthropic.com) into a clean academic-style PDF using LaTeX with the public NeurIPS 2024 template. Output PDFs are labelled as unofficial archival renderings.
